elaine_sdr: Hey team — acme-pay just asked for a short POC window for BYO KMS + HSM. They want to validate rotation, key escrow, and billing impacts before signing. Do we have a checklist and a rough cost delta for customer-managed keys?

sam_ops: Quick notes: main blockers are network egress to their HSM provider, attestation flow, and rotation window (they require 4hr max downtime for key rollover). Also need KMS API throttling guidance.

kevin_sales_engineer: I can draft SOW language. Pricing: two options — 1) Managed KMS passthrough (no extra flat fee, usage + per-request uplifts) 2) Dedicated key proxy (monthly infra surcharge + per-token uplift). I'll pull numbers.

maria_sre: Ops checklist (short):
- whitelist outbound IPs (we provide CIDR)
- open port 443 to customer's HSM endpoint
- test TLS mutual auth certs + MTLS handshake
- validate 1k req/s for tokenization path
- KV cache bypass for BYO keys during rotation

tony_security: Security/Compliance asks from acme-pay: FIPS 140-2 attestation, HSM vendor cert, key separation proof, key import audit trail. We should prepare a redacted attestation PDF and sample audit logs.

elaine_sdr: They also sent a security questionnaire with 12 KMS-specific Qs. I'll paste a couple here: 
1) "Do you support CMK import and deletion logs?"
2) "What is the maximum key rotation outage?"

kevin_sales_engineer: Answers draft: 
1) Yes — we support CMK import/delete and emit audit events to the customer audit log (S3/CloudWatch/etc). Link: https://docs.redwood.example/byo-keys (placeholder).
2) Rotation outage depends on HSM vendor and replication. SRE target: 0-30s for seamless inline rotation with KV cache warmup, worst-case fallback <4hrs with auto-fallback to hosted model variant.

sam_ops: Important operational caveat: the seamless path requires prefix cache warmup and coordinated cutover. If customer insists on cold-import-only rotation, plan for manual window ~2-4hrs.

maria_sre: To validate during POC we need: a dedicated test key, a pre-signed API cert for their HSM, and a staging project with traffic generator. I'll add a small runbook snippet: 
```
1) Provision test key in customer HSM.
2) Configure Redwood key-proxy config: 
   - endpoint: https://hsm.acme-pay.example
   - client_cert: /path/to/p12
3) Start generator at 50r/s for 15m.
4) Trigger rotation: import new key, flip routing, monitor 5xx/latency.
```

tony_security: Also flag: legal wants key escrow exception documented (they don't want us to hold plaintext keys). We'll include a bake-off note: escrow only for emergency under customer-controlled 2-person ceremony.

elaine_sdr: Customer asked if rotation counts as billable event. Kevin?

kevin_sales_engineer: I'd say rotations are not billed separately unless we provide managed rotation ops (on-call runbook support). Automated API-driven rotations are included in usage price; manual ops support is charged hourly or as an add-on. I'll propose: one complimentary rotation during POC; thereafter, add-on.

sam_ops: Can someone confirm expected latency delta for BYO KMS path? acme-pay is sensitive.

maria_sre: Measured delta on similar customers: median +18ms median tail +50ms when proxying to external HSM in same region. Cross-region hops add ~150-300ms. We should call this out in the SOW and in the POC acceptance criteria.

tony_security: Also need to supply key lifecycle policy snippet for questionnaire: 
- rotation frequency: customer-defined (recommended 90 days)
- destructive delete: allowed only with 2-actor authorization + 24h grace window
- audit retention: 1 year by default, extendable

elaine_sdr: Next actions: Kevin to send initial SOW + pricing delta by EOD, Maria to attach runbook/test vectors, Tony to prepare attestation redaction and questionnaire answers. I'll schedule a 30m sync with acme-pay for Wed 10am PT.

kevin_sales_engineer: On it. assigning internal ticket: #PD-4729.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging-key-proxy v0.9.2 -> staging at 2024-05-14T03:12:00Z :rocket:

sam_ops: One more FYI — if acme-pay requires HSM-level key split across two custodians, that triggers a separate engineering design. Flagging as potential scope bump.

elaine_sdr: noted. tagging legal if that becomes required. :eyes:

tony_security: LGTM. I'll draft the questionnaire answers and post a redacted attestation PDF here when ready. :thumbsup:

maria_sre: I'll prepare perf numbers and a short test harness repo link.

elaine_sdr: Thanks all — I'll update acme-pay and confirm Wed sync.
